description: Drug entity registry. Each row describes a specific drug (not a class) with FKs into MOA, sponsor, and indication registries. Lexicon clusters that represent a specific drug carry a drug_id FK into this registry. Drug-class clusters (e.g. glp_1, calcineurin_inhibitors, ace_arb) reference the MOA registry directly via moa_id on the cluster (when wired) — they do NOT get a row here. Brand names are duplicated between this file and cluster.variants until the matcher learns to inline them; treat this file as the authoritative metadata.

items.label: Mycophenolate (CellCept / Myfortic)
items.description: First-line immunosuppressant for lupus nephritis induction and maintenance; also widely used in transplant.

items.label: Cyclophosphamide (Cytoxan)
items.description: Alkylating immunosuppressant for induction in severe lupus nephritis; given IV (NIH or Euro-Lupus regimens) or orally.

items.label: Voclosporin (Lupkynis)
items.description: Calcineurin inhibitor approved 2021 for active lupus nephritis, added on top of mycophenolate and steroids.

items.label: Belimumab (Benlysta)
items.description: Anti-BLyS/BAFF monoclonal antibody approved for SLE (2011) and lupus nephritis (2020); IV infusion or subcutaneous injection.

items.label: Corticosteroids (prednisone)
items.description: Glucocorticoids — prednisone, methylprednisolone pulses — the backbone of induction therapy, tapered over time. The cluster is a drug-class shorthand; this entity represents the family.

items.label: Hydroxychloroquine (Plaquenil)
items.description: Antimalarial background therapy recommended for nearly all lupus patients; reduces flares and renal damage.

items.label: Azathioprine (Imuran)
items.description: Immunosuppressant used for lupus nephritis maintenance, including during pregnancy.

items.label: Rituximab (Rituxan)
items.description: Anti-CD20 B-cell-depleting antibody. Used off-label for refractory lupus nephritis; on-label for non-Hodgkin lymphoma and rheumatoid arthritis.

items.label: Anifrolumab (Saphnelo)
items.description: Type-I interferon receptor antagonist approved for SLE; investigated in lupus nephritis.

items.label: Obinutuzumab (Gazyva)
items.description: Glycoengineered anti-CD20 antibody investigated for lupus nephritis (REGENCY trial); approved for CLL and follicular lymphoma.

items.label: Semaglutide (Wegovy / Ozempic / Rybelsus)
items.description: GLP-1 receptor agonist; approved for type-2 diabetes (Ozempic, Rybelsus) and chronic weight management (Wegovy).

items.label: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro / Zepbound)
items.description: Dual GLP-1 / GIP receptor agonist; approved for type-2 diabetes (Mounjaro) and chronic weight management (Zepbound).

items.label: Cagrilintide
items.description: Long-acting amylin analog under investigation, often in combination with semaglutide (CagriSema).

items.label: Retatrutide
items.description: Triple GLP-1 / GIP / glucagon receptor agonist; investigational for obesity and type-2 diabetes.

items.label: Orforglipron
items.description: Oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist; investigational for obesity and type-2 diabetes.

items.label: Metformin
items.description: First-line biguanide for type-2 diabetes; used off-label for prediabetes and weight management.

items.label: Phentermine
items.description: Short-term sympathomimetic appetite suppressant for obesity.

items.label: Ocrelizumab (Ocrevus)
items.description: Anti-CD20 B-cell-depleting antibody approved for relapsing and primary progressive MS; 600 mg IV every 6 months.

items.label: Ofatumumab (Kesimpta)
items.description: Anti-CD20 B-cell-depleting antibody for relapsing MS; subcutaneous self-injection monthly. Same class as ocrelizumab but home-administered.

items.label: Ublituximab (Briumvi)
items.description: Glycoengineered anti-CD20 antibody for relapsing MS; shorter (~1 hour) infusion than ocrelizumab.

items.label: Natalizumab (Tysabri)
items.description: Alpha-4 integrin antagonist for relapsing MS; IV every 4 weeks via TOUCH program. High efficacy offset by PML risk in JCV-antibody-positive patients.

items.label: Fingolimod (Gilenya)
items.description: First oral DMT for relapsing MS; S1P receptor modulator. First-dose cardiac monitoring required; macular edema and infection risks.

items.label: KYV-101 (anti-CD19 CAR-T)
items.description: Investigational autologous anti-CD19 CAR-T (fully human binder) in clinical development for lupus nephritis, progressive MS, myasthenia gravis, and other antibody-mediated autoimmune diseases.

items.label: CABA-201 (anti-CD19 CAR-T)
items.description: Investigational autologous anti-CD19 CAR-T in development for lupus nephritis, generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic sclerosis, idiopathic inflammatory myopathies, and MS.

items.label: Descartes-08 (anti-BCMA CAR-T)
items.description: Investigational autologous mRNA-engineered anti-BCMA CAR-T; non-lentiviral, given outpatient without lymphodepletion. In trials for myasthenia gravis and being explored in MS.
